outcome.description: recorded means all accepted lessons are recorded or already documented and all changes are pushed; already_documented means all lessons were already covered; blocked means some assigned work remains incomplete.

learning.description: The supplied reusable lesson and its applicable conditions; do not invent a lesson to fill this field.

evidence.description: Source references supporting the lesson. For already_documented, include the guidance location.

destination_pr_url.description: First documentation PR URL, retained for compatibility; empty if none exists. Use destination_pr_urls for the full set.

files_changed.description: Guidance paths changed by this assignment.

reason.description: What was recorded, where the lesson is already documented, or the failed step and evidence or decision needed to proceed.

destination_pr_urls.description: All documentation PR URLs for this ticket writeback, across repositories; empty when none exist.
